//: A second config, because the first one is read by Rollup (D132).
`node --test` runs TypeScript directly, but its loader only strips types --
it does not resolve module specifiers -- so a relative import has to name
the real file, `./rails.ts`. TypeScript accepts that only under
@rollup/plugin-typescript sets `noEmit: false` to get its output. Putting the
flag in `tsconfig.json` therefore fails the build with TS5096 -- measured,
not assumed. So the flag lives here, with the test directory, and
`tsconfig.json` stays the config a bundler can use.
`types: ["node"]` is scoped to this config for the same reason: the panel and
the card run in a browser, and `@types/node`'s globals have no business being
in scope while they are checked.
